service.name: dns
service.description: Rig resolver stack (per dns VM): redis + coredns + dns-bridge.
service._comment_assets: dns-seed = the bootstrap zone artifact. The ref is the COMPLETE sequence, authored here as data (every ${var} is a verbatim bootstrap key) — the orchestrator composes nothing; the loader may equally supply such a ref from discovery. compose-up (dev) skips asset staging by design — vm-stack fills the volume from seed/; Step 2's attested run pulls the artifact. Volume stays keep until that run refills it (recreate would wipe the dev fill).
